[SWS_CM_10058] String start byte(
BOM
)
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00201, RS_CM_00202, RS_CM_00211
⌈
All strings shall always start with a Byte Order Mark (
BOM
).
⌋
For the specification of
BOM
, see [17] and [18]. Please note that the
BOM
is used in the
serialized strings to achieve compatibility with Unicode.
